prior_knowledge: Case B and census aggregates already known; this is NOT outcome-blinded. Lock precedes new individual candidate analysis.
algorithm: Exclude a transaction containing ANY reported bad-debt assets or shares from these three primary strata; report bad debt population separately, not as unprofitable.
Single-debt-asset transactions only for ranking; sum principal in native integer units within transaction.
Up to four WETH transactions in descending repaid principal, transaction hash tie-break.
Choose non-WETH asset with most clean single-asset transactions (address tie-break); up to four descending principal within THAT asset only.
Up to four remaining debt assets: earliest transaction per asset, order by block, index, hash. No duplicate, substitution or quota refill.
